title: Conflict-safe artifact E2E
description: Exercise the new conflict-safe artifact contract without git push. (1) Update artifact-relay-e2e.txt so its exact content becomes: Studio safely updated this file through Bridge. Before editing, obtain the current Git blob SHA and submit it as base_sha. (2) Create artifact-relay-second.txt with exact content: Second artifact from Studio. Submit base_sha null for the create artifact. Run npm test and npm run lint. Submit both files through Studio Relay artifacts and leave the task in review. Do not git push and do not approve.
